notes:
I couldn't write the notes. My research tool stopped working before I could read any of the pages.

I asked for six pages: the Enduring Word commentary on Micah 3, the Precept Austin Micah 3 page, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on Bible Hub, and Wesley's notes on StudyLight. My code broke while reading the results, and the tool then refused any more calls for this turn. So none of what those pages say ever reached me.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and give a URL for every point. Anything I wrote now would come from my own memory with no source behind it, so I've left it all out.

If you send the request again (for example, "continue"), I'll start over with those same pages. After that I'll look for:
- **Other Protestant traditions:** Spurgeon, Desiring God, Grace to You, Ligonier and Lutheran sources, mainly on the Spirit-filled prophet in v. 8 and the false sense of safety in v. 11.
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey, Catholic and Orthodox sources, and any site that discusses Micah 3:11 in connection with prosperity or word-of-faith teaching.

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, with a URL for each point.
